from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class UniversityMetrics(BaseModel):
    """Metrics extracted from a single university's Common Data Set report."""
    university_name: str | None = Field(description="The name of the university, as identified in the document")
    first_year_applicants_count: float | None = Field(description="The total number of first-time, first-year degree-seeking applicants reported")
    first_year_applicants_reporting_year: str | None = Field(description="The year or reporting cycle associated with the applicant count (e.g. 'Fall 2021', 'Fall 2015')")
    six_year_graduation_rate: float | None = Field(description="The six-year graduation rate as a number (e.g. 73.5 for 73.5%)")
    graduation_cohort_year: str | None = Field(description="The cohort year associated with the graduation rate (e.g. 'Fall 2015', 'Fall 2014')")
    data_source_section_applicants: str | None = Field(description="The CDS section where applicant data was found (e.g. 'C1')")
    data_source_section_graduation: str | None = Field(description="The CDS section where graduation rate was found (e.g. 'B4')")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    universities: list[UniversityMetrics]
